name: openframe-studio
description: OpenFrame Studio — local-first desktop filmmaking studio (Tauri v2 + React + Rust + SQLite).

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-ai-assets.mjs --optional && npm --workspace apps/desktop run tauri -- dev --config src-tauri/tauri.bundled-ai.conf.json
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-ai-assets.mjs && node scripts/with-msvc-linker.mjs npm --workspace apps/desktop run tauri -- build --config src-tauri/tauri.bundled-ai.conf.json
scripts.bundle: node scripts/prepare-ai-assets.mjs && node scripts/with-msvc-linker.mjs npm --workspace apps/desktop run tauri -- build --bundles nsis,msi --config src-tauri/tauri.bundled-ai.conf.json
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm --workspace apps/desktop run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:web
scripts.perf: node scripts/with-msvc-linker.mjs cargo test --profile perf -p openframe-application --test perf -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
scripts.check:governance: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:migrations && npm run check:feature-status && npm run check:reachability && npm run check:writing && npm run check:links && node scripts/plan-status.mjs --check && node --test scripts/tests/governance.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:governance && npm run test
